column2: Software Development using AI
UG

This course examines modern AI-native software development, where developers collaborate with increasingly capable coding agents. It covers how to define intent, provide effective context, structure development workflows, and coordinate AI tools. Students gain practical experience designing and evaluating agent-assisted software development processes. Targeted at third and fourth-year Bachelor of Technology students, the course matters because it prepares engineers for emerging paradigms where autonomous tools integrate directly into the software lifecycle. Upon completion, students will be able to configure AI-assisted coding tools and developer workspaces, translate requirements into executable specifications, deconstruct iterative development loops, evaluate the reliability and performance of AI-generated code, and execute comprehensive AI-native software development projects. The course is taught through a combination of lectures, tutorials, laboratory sessions, and a semester-long project using student development machines and software development environments.

Course Code: Configure AI-assisted coding tools and developer workflows, using an agent orchestration framework and prompt context configurations, such that automated development tasks are executed with at least 80% passing acceptance tests.
column2: Translate high-level software requirements into executable specifications, using spec-driven development guidelines and requirement mapping templates, covering every use case in the supplied requirements document.
column3: Deconstruct iterative software development loops and agent interactions, using software factory pipelines and loop engineering metrics, identifying at least three distinct failure causes with supporting log evidence from the execution trace.
column4: Evaluate the reliability and performance of AI-generated code and deployment pipelines, using automated testing frameworks and evaluation suites, justifying each assessment decision against stated quality criteria.
column5: Evaluate an AI-native software development project, using coding agents, MCP tools, and automated evaluation frameworks, such that the delivered system satisfies every acceptance criterion agreed at the first milestone.
